visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a young woman in a red-and-white striped tube top and blue jeans standing in an outdoor urban setting. She holds a white smartphone with a prominent circular camera module, smiling and looking into the lens. The background features a textured wall, green plants, and a modern building facade with natural daylight. (2) Transition to a wide shot of the woman jumping happily in a park area. Behind her is a colorful, large-scale typography installation that reads 'Brave New Origin'. The lighting is bright and clear, indicating a sunny day. She is wearing the same outfit and appears very energetic, gesturing with her arms wide open. (3) The scene shifts to a dark indoor launch event. A large screen displays 'Looks Smooth' and 'Feels Smooth'. A presenter is visible on stage in the distance, while the foreground shows a crowd of people holding up their phones to capture the moment. The lighting is dominated by blue and white stage lights. (4) A series of close-up shots of a hand interacting with the smartphone's screen. The UI is showcased, including customizable lock screens, 'Atomic Island' folder interactions, and a private space feature. The background is a blurred retail or exhibition environment with soft indoor lighting. (5) The video presents a montage of photos taken with the phone. The woman is seen at the Shanghai Bund at night with city lights reflecting on the water, and at a Disney-themed park featuring characters like Elsa and a green toy soldier. (6) The final shot shows the woman at night on a street, holding the phone to take a selfie. She wears the same striped top and makes a peace sign. On-screen text displays the price for the vivo X300 and X300 Pro models.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A high-pitched, energetic female voice begins a fast-paced narration in Mandarin Chinese. The tone is professional yet enthusiastic, with a high speech rate and dynamic pitch variability. Simultaneously, an upbeat electronic pop BGM with a strong, rhythmic beat starts playing. A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect marks a visual transition. (2) The narration continues with high intensity, explaining the features of OriginOS 6. The BGM remains consistent in tempo, around 124 BPM, providing a high-arousal backdrop. Strategic 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are used to emphasize text overlays appearing on screen. There is minimal ambient noise, suggesting a clean studio-style voiceover track. (3) As the video demos phone features, the voice maintains high articulation clarity. Occasional 'click' sound effects accompany screen taps. The BGM volume ducks slightly to ensure the narration is dominant. The vocal arousal level stays high to match the fast-paced visual editing, with no significant pauses between phrases. (4) The audio shifts to include more percussive elements in the BGM as camera samples are shown. The narrator's tone remains friendly and persuasive. Faint ambient street noise and crowd chatter are audible in the background of the live-captured clips. A final 'ding' sound effect highlights the pricing information before the BGM fades out.
